questions.q: The length of the MAVLink 2 header, including the STX byte:
questions.explain: STX, len, incompat, compat, seq, sysid, compid, msgid(3) = 10.

questions.q: Why is CRC_EXTRA mixed into the CRC?
questions.explain: When the message definitions diverge, the frame is dropped; otherwise different dialects with the same length would yield garbage fields.

questions.q: The COMMAND_LONG payload in a frame is shorter than 33 bytes. This is:
options: A sender error: the frame was cut off
questions.explain: The receiver pads it with zeros to the full size.

questions.q: The field order of a message on the wire:
options: By type size, extensions at the end
The order the fields are declared in the XML
questions.explain: That is how mavgen aligns the struct.

questions.q: Adding an extension field to an existing message:
questions.explain: Extension fields are not part of CRC_EXTRA.
There is no encryption; for confidentiality, use a VPN or an encrypting radio.

questions.q: How does a receiver count lost frames?
options: From RSSI and the CRC error counter

questions.q: The signing key reaches ArduPilot in:
options: PARAM_SET over the radio with the key
questions.explain: Usually over USB; it is stored in flash.

questions.q: Your MAVLink 2 decoder rejects frames from a telemetry radio. The start of a frame:
options: The 0xFE start byte is MAVLink 1: the port is set to v1, or the radio forwards v1
Bad CRC: the radio reorders bytes, so the decoder cannot find the end of the frame
This message is signed: length 0x1c includes 13 signature bytes that are missing
msgid 0x1e does not exist in common.xml, so the frame is dropped as a foreign dialect
questions.explain: MAVLink 2 starts with 0xFD, MAVLink 1 with 0xFE; the header length differs.
